newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Guerrillas kill one Israeli, wound two in Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Guerrillas kill one Israeli, wound two in Lebanon.

text.p: Guerrillas fatally wounded one Israeli soldier and lightly injured two others in the Jewish state's south Lebanon occupation zone on Sunday, Israeli security sources said.

They said the incident occurred in the eastern sector of the zone when an Israeli tank set off a roadside charge. The soldier who was seriously wounded in the blast later died of his wounds. Army censors delayed publication of the report until Monday.
Israel Radio said the wounded soldiers waited several hours at the scene of the blast until they were evacuated.
Israel set up the 15 km (nine mile) -wide zone in 1985 to protect its northern border against guerrilla attack when it withdrew the bulk of its 1982 Lebanon invasion force.
Guerrilla groups, principally Hizbollah (Party of God), are fighting to oust Israel from the zone.
On Saturday, the Israeli army said guerrillas wounded one soldier in south Lebanon.
